source: notiontool/projects.py: project_view (list items) and project_detail (detail, adds commits). Stored in the objects table, kind 'projects'.

project_fields.name: string, not empty
project_fields.repo_path: string, absolute path of the project's git repo, may be empty
project_fields.main_chat_id: string, the one Main chat of the project, empty while none is set; always the first entry of chat_ids
project_fields.chat_ids: array of string, all chats of the project; a chat belongs to at most one active project
project_fields.coworker_ids: array of string, derived: workers that ran tasks of this project (tasks carry project_id), without the Main chat's own worker
project_fields.archived: boolean, derived from status; archived projects are hidden from the list, never deleted

commits_rule: Newest first, at most n (default 10, max 100). Empty array when repo_path is empty, missing or not a git repo.
